mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_index_job(event_id) SELECT event_id FROM ma_outbox WHERE aggregate_type = 'SOURCE' AND kind IN ('SOURCE_VERSION_CREATED','SOURCE_REINDEX','SOURCE_WITHDRAWN') AND status != 'DELIVERED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_index_job j WHERE j.event_id = ma_outbox.event_id) ORDER BY created_at,event_id LIMIT 100 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH chosen AS ( SELECT j.event_id FROM ma_index_job j JOIN ma_outbox e USING(event_id) WHERE e.aggregate_type = 'SOURCE' AND e.status != 'DELIVERED' AND (j.status = 'PROCESSING' OR (j.status = 'PENDING' AND j.attempts < 3)) AND j.next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (j.status != 'PROCESSING' OR j.lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY e.created_at,e.event_id FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ), claimed AS ( UPDATE ma_index_job SET status = 'PROCESSING', fence = fence + 1, attempts = LEAST(attempts + 1, 4), lease_until = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes' WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM chosen) RETURNING event_id,fence,attempts ) SELECT e.*,c.fence,c.attempts,j.call_state FROM claimed c JOIN ma_outbox e USING(event_id) JOIN ma_index_job j USING(event_id)
SELECT account_id FROM app_user WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT event_id FROM ma_index_job WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ma_retrieval_chunk WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_retrieval_chunk(chunk_id,account_id,source_id,version,anchor_id,question_id, text,method_tags,terms,embedding,embedding_model,dimensions,index_revision) VALUES(#{id},#{accountId},#{sourceId},#{version},#{anchorId},#{questionId},#{text}, CAST(#{methodTags} AS jsonb),CAST(#{terms} AS jsonb),CAST(#{vector} AS vector), #{model},#{dimensions},#{indexRevision})
mapper.update: UPDATE ma_index_job SET status = 'DONE',completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,failure_reason = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE ma_index_job SET status = 'FAILED',failure_reason = #{reason}, attempts = attempts - CASE WHEN #{reason} = 'EMBEDDING_DISABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, usage_uncertain = usage_uncertain OR (#{reason} = 'OUTCOME_UNKNOWN' AND call_state = 'CALL_INTENT'), next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '60 seconds' WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE ma_index_job SET lease_until = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes' WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE ma_index_job j SET call_state = 'CALL_INTENT' WHERE j.event_id = #{eventId} AND j.fence = #{fence} AND j.status = 'PROCESSING' AND j.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j.call_state IN ('NOT_SENT','CONFIRMED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_outbox e JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = e.aggregate_id AND s.account_id = e.account_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = e.aggregate_version WHERE e.event_id = j.event_id AND e.aggregate_type = 'SOURCE' AND e.kind IN ('SOURCE_VERSION_CREATED','SOURCE_REINDEX') AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.current_version = e.aggregate_version AND v.status = 'INDEX_PENDING' AND v.index_revision = e.index_revision)
UPDATE ma_index_job SET call_state = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND call_state = 'CALL_INTENT'

UPDATE ma_index_job SET ocr_calls = ocr_calls + #{ocrCalls}, embedding_requests = embedding_requests + #{embeddingRequests}, embedding_tokens = CASE WHEN #{tokens,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL THEN embedding_tokens ELSE COALESCE(embedding_tokens,0) + #{tokens,jdbcType=BIGINT} END, usage_uncertain = usage_uncertain OR #{uncertain} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_query_embedding(step_id,account_id,run_id,query_sha256, embedding_model,dimensions,call_state) SELECT step.step_id,r.account_id,r.run_id,#{querySha256},#{model},#{dimensions},'CALL_INTENT' FROM ma_step step JOIN ma_run r ON r.run_id = step.run_id JOIN ma_request req ON req.request_id = r.request_id AND req.account_id = r.account_id WHERE step.step_id = #{stepId} AND step.role = 'RETRIEVE' AND r.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.run_id = #{runId} AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND req.current_run_id = r.run_id AND step.sequence = (SELECT MAX(latest.sequence) FROM ma_step latest WHERE latest.run_id = r.run_id AND latest.role = 'RETRIEVE') ON CONFLICT (step_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE ma_outbox SET status = #{status} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND aggregate_type = 'SOURCE'
mapper.sql: FROM ma_retrieval_chunk c JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = c.source_id AND s.account_id = c.account_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = c.version JOIN ma_anchor a ON a.anchor_id = c.anchor_id AND a.source_id = c.source_id AND a.version = c.version WHERE c.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.current_version = c.version AND v.status = 'READY' AND v.index_revision = c.index_revision AND s.type IN ('QUESTION','SAVED_ANSWER','NOTE','TUTOR_REPLY') AND c.embedding_model = #{model} AND c.dimensions = #{dimensions}
mapper.select:
WITH authorized AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT c.*,s.type,v.answer_state, CASE WHEN s.type = 'TUTOR_REPLY' THEN ( SELECT reply_request.question_id::text FROM ma_result reply_result JOIN ma_run reply_run ON reply_run.run_id = reply_result.run_id JOIN ma_request reply_request ON reply_request.request_id = reply_run.request_id AND reply_request.account_id = reply_run.account_id WHERE reply_result.result_id = s.origin_id AND reply_run.account_id = s.account_id LIMIT 1 ) ELSE c.question_id END AS actual_question_id
), scores AS ( SELECT *,1 - (embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)) AS vector_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(terms) term WHERE jsonb_exists(CAST(#{terms} AS jsonb), term)) + 3 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(method_tags) tag WHERE jsonb_exists(CAST(#{methodTags} AS jsonb), tag)) AS lexical_score FROM authorized ), picked AS ( (SELECT chunk_id FROM scores ORDER BY vector_score DESC,chunk_id LIMIT 40) UNION (SELECT chunk_id FROM scores WHERE lexical_score > 0 ORDER BY lexical_score DESC,chunk_id LIMIT 40) ) SELECT source_id,version,anchor_id,type,actual_question_id AS question_id, answer_state,text,method_tags::text AS method_tags,vector_score,lexical_score FROM scores WHERE chunk_id IN (SELECT chunk_id FROM picked) ORDER BY lexical_score DESC,vector_score DESC,chunk_id

SELECT step.step_id FROM ma_step step JOIN ma_run r ON r.run_id = step.run_id JOIN ma_request req ON req.request_id = r.request_id AND req.account_id = r.account_id WHERE r.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.run_id = #{runId} AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND req.current_run_id = r.run_id AND step.role = 'RETRIEVE' ORDER BY step.sequence DESC LIMIT 1
